title: Aftermath and Glasshouse
author: Ada Pemberton
blurb: Wren Ishikawa, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the mother's memory goes entirely.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
